key_insight: ARDY enables real-time, interactive 3D human motion generation by combining streaming autoregressive diffusion with a hybrid representation that preserves both precise control and high motion quality.
engineering_relevance: The method is relevant for animation, simulation, and humanoid robotics because it supports online text prompts and long-horizon kinematic constraints without sacrificing responsiveness.
method: Hybrid motion representation: explicit root features + latent body embedding
Two-stage autoregressive transformer denoiser with variable history context
Direct conditioning on text labels and sampled kinematic constraints for online control
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong results on HumanML3D and the large-scale Bones Rigplay dataset, with improved motion quality and constraint adherence.
watch_item: Interactive performance may still depend on constraint quality, context length, and the availability of representative training data for diverse motion scenarios.
paper_title: ARDY: Autoregressive Diffusion with Hybrid Representation for Interactive Human Motion Generation
